goal: Deliver headless fix-pr repair dispatch for daemon-opened PRs (CI failure local reproduction and fix, conflict rebase, review comment disposition vs escalation, 2-attempt cap per (head_sha, failure_signature), mark_pr_ready, and close_out) under S7 (D8) of docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-REQ-5; meet S7 and D8 in docs/specs/loop-daemon.spec.md: repair_agent.ts handles daemon-managed PRs on imm/* and imm-loop/* by reproducing and repairing failing CI checks locally, rebasing base-branch conflicts, addressing in-scope review comments or escalating scope changes, enforcing a strict 2-attempt cap per (head_sha, failure_signature) before escalating, and executing mark_pr_ready and close_out.
